children: ADOBE: CONSUMERS HAVE SPENT $9.7 BILLION ONLINE SO FAR ON BLACK FRIDAY, REPRESENTING 12.8% GROWTH YOY
ADOBE: EXPECTS THAT CONSUMERS WILL SPEND BETWEEN $13.0 BILLION AND $13.4 BILLION ON NOV 27, A NEW ONLINE RECORD FOR BLACK FRIDAY
ADOBE: ON BLACK FRIDAY, AI TRAFFIC TO U.S. RETAIL SITES, MEASURED BY SHOPPERS CLICKING ON A LINK, IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE BY 95% YOY
ADOBE: FOR UPCOMING WEEKEND, ADOBE EXPECTS CONSUMERS WILL SPEND $6.1 BILLION ON NOV. 28 (UP 6.0% YOY) & $6.4 BILLION ON NOV. 29
ADOBE: BUY NOW PAY LATER IS EXPECTED TO DRIVE $807 MILLION IN ONLINE SPEND FOR BLACK FRIDAY, UP 8% YOY
ADOBE: MOBILE SHARE IS FORECASTED TO COME IN AROUND 56.8%, DRIVING BETWEEN $7.4 BILLION TO $7.6 BILLION IN BLACK FRIDAY SPEND
ADOBE: CYBER MONDAY IS SET TO REMAIN THE SEASON’S AND YEAR’S BIGGEST SHOPPING DAY, DRIVING A RECORD $15.1 BILLION IN ONLINE SPEND, UP 6.2% YOY
ADOBE: CYBER WEEK EXPECTED TO DRIVE $47.5 BILLION IN ONLINE SPEND, UP 7.4% YOY
